hypothesis: Optimizing DEATH_TOKEN with trader regime filters and entry/exit timing improves Sharpe from 1.11 to ~1.5.

optimizations.name: REGIME_FILTER
optimizations.rule: Only short when Timeless says DOWN or RANGE regime
optimizations.expected_impact: Eliminate UP regime losers, ~80% win rate

optimizations.name: ENTRY_TIMING
optimizations.rule: Short when XO says SHORT (4h) AND death_score > 75

optimizations.name: EXIT_TIMING
optimizations.rule: Exit when Timeless flips BULLISH or death_score < 50
optimizations.expected_impact: Capture more of the move, ~10% improvement

optimizations.name: ASSET_SCREENING
optimizations.rule: Avoid tokens at strong support levels (conceptual)

combined_rules.exit: Timeless flips BULLISH OR death_score < 50 OR 2-week time stop

falsification: If combined strategy Sharpe < 1.0 with n>100, reject.
